result.summary: The home screen is mostly clean and well laid out. The most visible defect is a loading spinner stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image. Minor issues include redundant delivery-fee information and low-contrast grey secondary text. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, suggesting the image or card failed to finish loading and looks stuck.
issues.suggestion: Show the loaded food photo, or hide the spinner once the image has loaded. Add a timeout and fallback placeholder if the image request fails.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the meta line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one place to reduce redundancy.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the search placeholder, delivery fees, and '25–35 min' meta text is light grey on white or light grey backgrounds, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the grey secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal-size text.
